newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Barnevik to leave Skanska chair.
newsitem.headline: Barnevik to leave Skanska chair.

text.p: Swedish business leader Percy Barnevik is to leave the position of chairman at construction company Skanska AB, a news conference was told on Thursday.
Barnevik was earlier named by investment company Investor AB as its replacement for Peter Wallenberg who will not stand for re-election as chairman at the company's AGM on April 14.
"Percy Barnveik will leave the Skanska board but will stay on the other boards on which he currently sits," Wallenberg told a news conference.
Investor's managing director Claes Dahlback said there was no firm decision on when Barnevik would leave the Skanska board.
Investor is the investment arm of Sweden's powerful Wallenberg family which is headed by Peter Wallenberg.
